characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Porygon is an artificial Pokémon made entirely of programming code that can alter its data to change its properties and attack using digital or physical strikes.

mechanisms: Data manipulation via Conversion to change type
Durability derived from its digital composition

mobility: Floating movement through digital environment manipulation
limitations: Cannot breathe in normal biological terms as it is made of code

sources.supports: Porygon abilities, artificial nature, moveset, and typing.

feats.claim: Changed its own type to match the opponent's type using Conversion.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Game Manual / Mechanics

campaignTags.claim: Porygon is an artificial Pokémon made of programming code.
Porygon is an artificial creation composed of computer code.

unknowns: Exact real-world translation of digital capabilities in physical combat.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Primeape is a fierce Fighting-type Pokémon that flies into uncontrollable rages and attacks with overwhelming physical martial arts strikes.

mechanisms: High physical stamina and endurance fueled by extreme anger

limitations: Prone to losing tactical focus due to uncontrollable rage.

sources.supports: Primeape typing, abilities, and combat behavior.

feats.claim: Pursued opponents relentlessly across vast distances when provoked into anger.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of its physical strength under maximum rage.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Psyduck is a Water-type Pokémon constantly troubled by headaches that unlock latent, powerful psychic abilities when the pain peaks.

mechanisms: Amnesiac unawareness that sometimes deflects psychological stress

limitations: Psychic powers are largely uncontrollable and depend entirely on headache severity.

sources.supports: Psyduck typing, headaches, and psychic/water abilities.

feats.claim: Used powerful psychic waves unconsciously while suffering from a migraine.

campaignTags.claim: Psyduck is a water-dwelling Pokémon capable of swimming and breathing underwater.
Psyduck is naturally adapted to swimming in water.
Psyduck can unleash psychic attacks when its headache peaks.

unknowns: The exact biological mechanism connecting its headaches to psychokinetic force.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Raichu is an Electric-type evolution of Pikachu that discharges high-voltage electricity through its tail and body to stun or knock out opponents.
limitations: Becomes aggressive if it stores too much electricity and must discharge it into the ground.

sources.supports: Raichu stats, electric abilities, and evolution mechanics.

feats.claim: Stored up to 100,000 volts of electricity in its body, capable of knocking out larger creatures.

campaignTags.claim: Raichu naturally generates and controls high-voltage electricity.
Raichu discharges up to 100,000 volts of electricity in combat.

unknowns: Exact voltage threshold before self-injury occurs.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Sun and Moon / Alola Region Continuity
characters.summary: Alolan Raichu is an Electric/Psychic-type variant that rides upon its own tail like a surfboard, utilizing psychokinetic energy to glide and attack.
characters.formDifferences: Adds Psychic-typing, changes appearance, and grants the ability to ride its tail using psychokinetic power to float.

sources.supports: Alolan Raichu regional variant typing and psychic abilities.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how regional adaptation altered its electrical sacs into psychic pathways.
